title: El insistente
goal: Say no four times to somebody who ignores the first three
culture: He is not being rude and neither are you. The escalation is the ritual: nobody expects the first no to work, and four polite ones are normal. Walking off in silence is the only move here that actually reads as contempt.

beats.es: ¡Amigo! Hamacas, hamacas. Le hago precio especial.
beats.good: The first no, and nobody expects it to work — including him. It is not ignored so much as noted.

beats.es: Mire nomás, sin compromiso. ¿De qué color la quiere?
beats.good: Ya tengo hands him a reason instead of a wall, and it works about half the time. It is the only one of the four that is a fact.

beats.es: ¿Y una para la esposa? ¿Para la mamá? Le dejo dos por el precio de una.
beats.good: De verdad no is firm without being cross. Getting cross is what would be rude; a third no is not.

beats.es: Bueno, bueno. Ahí cuando quiera, amigo.
beats.good: Wishing him well on the way out is what turns four noes into a conversation. He will remember you kindly and try again tomorrow, and that is fine.
